title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
subtitle: One Runtime, One MDP, Three Drivers
abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning. MagicSim is an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared MDP, exposed through three drivers (benchmark/RL, scripted AutoCollect, agent/VLM interaction). YAML-first specifications construct diverse executable worlds; a Command->Skill->Planner->Robot->Record pipeline grounds high-level commands into robot actions; successful rollouts become structured multimodal trajectories.
